description: Rank up to 25 recent TED notices using optional CPV and business keywords. Returns transparent rule-based scores, not eligibility decisions. Searches only a recent sample, not all TED notices. Free, read-only.

country.description: Buyer country ISO-3, e.g. ROU, DEU, FRA.

cpv.description: Optional 8-digit CPV filter. The TED query is restricted to this CPV.

keywords.description: Business services or products, e.g. ["cybersecurity", "network"]. Keywords are only used for local ranking, not inserted into TED queries.

scan_limit.description: Maximum recent TED notices to inspect, 1–25.

name: match_tenders
title: Match EU tenders to business keywords
